purpose: Preserve the proven LuHm OS vendor/API pipeline unification, correct the overbroad VOWEL_RIP scope, and keep historical evidence without rewriting it.
source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. The human promotes.

naming_scope.human_facing_rule: Use readable canonical names. Do not transform a vendor/project/domain/repository name merely to satisfy coding shorthand.
naming_scope.endpoint_rule: Use named endpoints in operator-facing doctrine. Do not promote literal network addresses into canonical names.

pipeline_seal.proof_boundary: Historical exact-head CI receipts remain valid historical evidence. This crown does not invent a fresh CI run for the current head.

ten_pass_audit.finding: LuHm OS remains the readable canonical product name; luhm_os remains the established internal project identifier.
VOWEL_RIP is limited to shortened Python3/coding/stub identifiers and is not a platform-wide naming law.
Pirate Daddy Film contains canonical LuHm OS and legacy Project Hydra projects; new canonical work targets LuHm OS.
OpenAI, Google, GitHub, Cloudflare, and Hugging Face remain transport bindings of one LuHm OS logical project.
Vendor manifest, deterministic Python3 audit guard, and GitHub workflow are present on luhmos-main.
Prior exact-head receipts record 17/17 then 18/18 internal CI success; no fresh CI run is fabricated for the current head.
KAI 9000 is donor/reference only; Project Hydra is compatibility/history and cannot become a new vendor target.
Normal admin by default; one exact Crown-approved sudo operation; immediate return to normal admin; no persistent root.
Source/CI proof and live-provider proof remain separate; external debt is not silently promoted to GREEN.
This crown supersedes the overbroad 2026-09-21 naming crown while preserving prior pipeline/unification receipts and historical evidence.

supersession.reason: The superseded crown incorrectly applied VOWEL_RIP to the LuHm OS product identity, provider bindings, FQDN naming, and general machine namespace.

external_debt_preserved: No fresh OpenAI live-inference smoke is claimed by this crown.
Google WIF live auth remains evidence-dependent and is not auto-promoted.
GitHub branch protection and repository rulesets remain separate governance evidence.
Cloudflare live account/token/tunnel state remains separately verifiable.
Hugging Face live inference remains separately verifiable.

final_crowned_goal.summary: One readable LuHm OS identity across API projects, vendor bindings, documentation, GitHub lineage, Drive recovery, and public infrastructure. Internal Python3/stub shorthand may use VOWEL_RIP when useful, but the brand and provider names do not. The five-vendor pipeline remains guarded by deterministic source contracts and historical CI proof. Professor is final authority, Lum is Boss, Oni helpers are bounded, local execution is Crown-gated and evidence-backed, normal admin is the default, and root is only a temporary operation context.
